label: 1. You all are a bunch of busy bees, aren't you?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You all are a bunch of busy bees, aren't you?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Impressive.
How are things at Talentum?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: It's a hot mess over here, thanks to the shelter situation.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: They keep asking for supplies left and right.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: The demand for daily necessities and medical supplies is at an all-time high.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: The reserves at the shelters are stocked to accommodate the suggested max capacity.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Due to this incident, however, there are more people crammed into these shelters than the allotted capacity.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That means that supplies are dwindling fast.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: The Merchant Union is providing as much as we can,

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: but we're having trouble keeping up with the demand for certain essential goods.
Like drinking water?
Like food?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: No, not that.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We're able to supply those without any issues.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: What we're short of is even more essential than that.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: we were preparing a shipment,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: but it got raided en route, mid-delivery.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Luckily, none of our employees were injured,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and the supplies weren't seriously damaged,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: but now it's gonna be a real ordeal getting them to the destination.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: If it's not too much trouble, any chance you could help with that?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: There are still rogue Raptures wandering near that area,

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: and none of our employees are able to get close to the supplies.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: If you can eliminate them,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: we'll take care of the rest.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I would do it myself,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: but I've got enough on my plate at the Merchant Union as is.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: If we stretch ourselves too thin trying to handle everything ourselves, it could negatively affect our other supply shipments.
Tell me the location.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Thank you, Sweetie!

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I'll make this up to you personally.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Must you always be so brazen with your flirting?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: You're just jelly!
